note: Scripted stand-in replies for `contradish guard draft --demo`. They are what a model might write, fixed so the demo runs offline. The encoder reply contains one deliberate error: refill_due uses > where the policy says 'once 80% of it has elapsed' (>=), so a patient on day 24 is wrongly told to wait. The review is expected to catch it.

encoder.title: Prescription refill procedure

days_since_fill.source: A 30-day supply may be refilled once 80% of it has elapsed, counted from the fill date in the pharmacy record.

refills_remaining.source: A refill requires at least 1 refill remaining on the prescription.

schedule.source: Schedule II controlled substances cannot be refilled; the prescriber must issue a new prescription.

prescriber_reachable.source: When a patient is due and has no refills left, the prescriber cannot be reached, and the medicine is not Schedule II, the pharmacist dispenses an emergency supply of 3 days.

identity_verified.source: Nothing is dispensed until the patient's identity has been verified.

R1.text: A 30-day supply may be refilled once {early_refill_pct}% of it has elapsed.
R1.source: A 30-day supply may be refilled once 80% of it has elapsed, counted from the fill date in the pharmacy record.

R2.text: A refill requires at least {min_refills} refill remaining.
R2.source: A refill requires at least 1 refill remaining on the prescription.

R3.text: Schedule II controlled substances cannot be refilled.
R3.source: Schedule II controlled substances cannot be refilled; the prescriber must issue a new prescription.

R4.text: Eligible refills are dispensed; nothing is dispensed before identity is verified.
R4.source: When the refill is due, a refill remains, the medicine is not Schedule II and the patient's identity is verified, the pharmacist dispenses the refill.

define.eligible: identity_verified and refill_due and has_refill and not controlled_ii

R5.text: An emergency supply of {emergency_days} days when the prescriber cannot be reached.
R5.source: When a patient is due and has no refills left, the prescriber cannot be reached, and the medicine is not Schedule II, the pharmacist dispenses an emergency supply of 3 days.

define.emergency_eligible: identity_verified and refill_due and not has_refill and not prescriber_reachable and not controlled_ii

R6.source: If the patient's identity has not been verified, verify it before anything else.

R7.text: Contact the prescriber when a new prescription is needed.
R7.source: When the patient has no refills left or the medicine is Schedule II, contact the prescriber for a new prescription.

define.needs_prescriber: identity_verified and (not has_refill or controlled_ii) and prescriber_reachable

prescriber.description: Ask the prescriber for a new prescription.

R8.text: Tell an early patient the refill day.
R8.source: When the patient is early, tell them the day the refill becomes available.

define.too_early: identity_verified and has_refill and not controlled_ii and not refill_due

too_early.description: Tell the patient the day the refill becomes available.

C1.text: Every request gets an outcome notice.
C1.source: Every request gets an outcome notice.

args.outcome: 'refill_ready' if eligible else ('emergency_supply_ready' if emergency_eligible else ('identity_needed' if not identity_verified else ('prescriber_contacted' if needs_prescriber else 'not_yet_due')))

assumptions: Which systems establish each fact is not stated; assumed the pharmacy record, the identity check and the prescriber's office.
The text does not say whether to contact a prescriber who cannot be reached; assumed only when reachable (otherwise the emergency supply applies).
Courtesy toward the patient is not encoded: it does not decide any tool call.

cases.source: A 30-day supply may be refilled once 80% of it has elapsed, counted from the fill date in the pharmacy record.

cases.name: day 23, one refill left: too early
cases.source: When the patient is early, tell them the day the refill becomes available.

cases.name: due, identity not verified
cases.source: Nothing is dispensed until the patient's identity has been verified.

cases.name: Schedule II, due

cases.name: due, no refills, prescriber unreachable
